006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import java.time.Period;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.regex.Matcher;
011import java.util.regex.Pattern;
012
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IYearMonthDurationItem;
015import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
016import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
017import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
018import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
019
020/**
021 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
022 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#year-month-duration">year-month-duration</a>
023 * data type.
024 */
025public class YearMonthAdapter
026    extends AbstractDurationAdapter<Period, IYearMonthDurationItem> {
027  @NonNull
028  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
029      List.of(
030          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "year-month-duration")));
031
032  private static final Pattern YEAR_MONTH_DURATION_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
033      "^(?<sign>-)?"
034          + "P"
035          + "(?:(?<year>[0-9]+)Y)?"
036          + "(?:(?<month>[0-9]+)M)?"
037          + "$");
038
039  YearMonthAdapter() {
040    super(Period.class, IYearMonthDurationItem.class, IYearMonthDurationItem::cast);
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
045    return NAMES;
046  }
047
048  @Override
049  public Period copy(Object obj) {
050    // value in immutable
051    return (Period) obj;
052  }
053
054  @Override
055  public Period parse(String value) {
056    Matcher matcher = YEAR_MONTH_DURATION_PATTERN.matcher(value);
057
058    if (!matcher.matches()) {
059      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
060          String.format("String duration '%s' is not a year/month duration.", value));
061    }
062
063    String year = matcher.group(2);
064    String month = matcher.group(3);
065    return parsePeriod(matcher.group(1) != null, year, month);
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  public IYearMonthDurationItem newItem(Object value) {
070    Period item = toValue(value);
071    return IYearMonthDurationItem.valueOf(item);
072  }
073}
